subject: maths
question:
Refer to the given series and answer the question that follows. (All numbers are single digit numbers only.) Counting to be done from left to right only.

(Left) 9 6 9 4 7 8 9 9 1 6 7 3 6 5 9 7 4 7 1 7 7 8 3 4 6 9 3 (Right)

How many such even numbers are there, each of which is immediately preceded by an odd number and also immediately followed by an even number?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Condition to check: **Odd Number → Even Number → Even Number** Instead of checking every single number, directly scan the series for two consecutive even numbers. The only consecutive even numbers in the entire series are **4 and 6** near the end. Check the number before 4: It is **3** (an Odd number). Thus, the triplet **3, 4, 6** is the only one that perfectly satisfies the required condition. **∴ The correct answer is 1.**
